generator: three.js WebGL via runtime ModelLibrary in headless Chromium (SwiftShader); art-factory/rts/tools/unit_train_icon_capture.mjs + unit_train_icon_viewer.ts
generator_routing_note: Project CLAUDE.md routes images to nanobanana-image-gen, but that skill is not installed on this machine; codex is only on explicit user request. Followed the existing building-production-icons precedent (original_3d_render of published original GLBs), which needs no image generator.

alpha_policy.exception: Native transparent WebGL clear (alpha 0) instead of magenta chroma key: no backdrop exists to key out, and metal/blue team cloth keeps exact color without key-spill risk. Same exception as building-production-icons.
alpha_policy.intentional_holes: Original model silhouette gaps only (arm/body, siege frame and wheels); no erase operation
alpha_policy.bust_cut: Deliberate straight crop at the render frame edge (bust framing); lies inside the 128px canvas margin

forbidden: rejected or candidate paths in runtime
qa_gates: side-by-side with existing command icons at 48px

consumers: src/scripts/games/rts/hud.ts unitIcon(): train + revive buttons, multi-select list thumbnails
